classification: Explicit /changes reconstruction and View preparation (cold lifecycle). Mutation production, Evidence Ledger lookup, render/input and terminal delivery unchanged.

audit: Native request -> current authorization/path binding -> canonical intent/preparation -> commit -> Session receipt/result; nested Codemode persists custom call/result. Producers and durable schema are unchanged.

/changes (idle UI command) -> indexed recentMutationEntries (512) -> collectChanges -> collectStructuredMutationReceipts -> unique/order/hash/intent validation -> command selection -> displayMetadata -> batchExpandedSummary/PreviewBudget -> showChangeViewer -> cached visible rows -> existing UI/frame queue -> ChangeViewer.dispose.

collectChanges already owns bounded branch slices, request/entry/order maps, conflict sets, recovery objects and argument hashes at command time. Adds one existing entry-ID string reference per call and per projected record, no extra index/container/full-history scan.

View creates one bounded provenance string and adds it to the existing bounded heading once per explicit opening. It reads no files and adds no history writes, model requests, listeners, timers, pool, preimage backup or retry permission.

Normal render/input retain existing numeric indices, viewport output rows and cached array reuse. Closure/Promise/AbortController/wrapper/array additions per frame/update are zero; existing viewport rows are not claimed allocation-free.

Command-local branch/maps/records live only through the command/dialog. Report body, numeric scrolling state, cached rows and TUI/done references clear on dialog disposal. No new process or resource is created by the feature.

limitations: Locations are in the viewed Session history, not proof of original executor identity. Fork copies preserve entry IDs.
Cross-session/subagent task lineage and automatic/explicit rollback are not implemented. Native receipts and displayed diffs are not backup data.
Missing/ambiguous/unbound history suppresses request attribution. Preview/preparation entries remain non-execution facts.
Shell/network/database/unrecorded subagent side effects are outside this file ledger. Existing current-state verification does not grant replay authority.
